original.markdown:
Great write-up! I tried `--n-cpu-moe 44` on my RTX 3060 and generation went from 18 to 27 tok/s. Did you notice any **quality loss** with the KV cache in q4_0?

```bash
llama-server -c 32768 --n-cpu-moe 44
```
